title: Doubling instruments in the photo
summary: They puzzle over a trumpet, flute and Boehm-system clarinets visible in the picture.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone

blocks.x: It looks like the Nina Pecone has a double. It looks like the Nina Pecone has a trumpet next to him. I don't know why.
Would that be a vibraphone, that? He moved it on the side? No, it's a trumpet next to him.
I never heard of him playing trumpet. No, no, he never played trumpet. It must be Almerico's trumpet. Yeah, it must be Tony's.
And I think I see a flute and a couple of Bames system clarinets.
Well, Dave played a little bit of flute. He brought it there to take the picture, I believe.
